source: evals/climb-history.json: real runs of evals/hill.mjs against BRANE (draft policies, POST /policy/test) on Omar Shalaby's selection split omar-val, and of evals/legal.mjs on the hard legal questions. start is the baseline before the first change, end is after the last kept change.
